I am old now, 68 years, and this small bean plot is mine to look after. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they pull their own goodness from the soil, my mother taught me this long ago. I have small cash from selling a few things, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for the beans, but I keep a little manure from the chickens and goats that I spread around. I save my own bean seeds from last season like always, and I weed myself with my hoe when my back allows.
